newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nautica Enterprises cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nautica Enterprises cut.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said on Tuesday it lowered its rating on the shares of Nautica Enterprises Inc to outperform from buy, due to weaker-than-expected retails trends.

-- Analyst Allison Malkin said in a research note that while the company's brand was outperforming some competitors, Nautica's largest department store customers said the men's collections area was not growing as fast as last year.

-- "We do not believe that our first-quarter estimate is at risk, since the quarter ended in May and does not include the Father's Day holiday," she said. "However, if sluggish results continue at retail, the company's gross margins may be at risk due to higher markdowns to clear goods."
